Definitions.AiPurchaseEvaluations: Candidate visits in the ranked shortlist, before seller-removal validation. Not every player scanned by the query.
Definitions.AiPurchaseAttempts: ExecuteTransfer calls after identity/idempotency checks, plus new formal offer submissions. A submission and its later execution are separate stages; bids are excluded.
Definitions.AiOffersSubmitted: Unique TransferOffer.Id attributed to SubmittedByManagerId at submission.
Definitions.AiOffersAccepted: Completed TransferPurchase with TransactionType AcceptedOffer, attributed to execution-time ManagerId.
Definitions.AiPurchasesCompleted: TransferPurchase + AuctionPurchase, counted once by purchase-row Id. Free assignments and renewals excluded.
Definitions.AiAuctionBids: Actual bid increases recorded as AiAuctionBid, including losing bids.
Definitions.AiAuctionsWon: Successfully settled AuctionPurchase; not bids or unsold auctions.
Definitions.AiSalesCompleted: TransferSale attributed to the seller manager at execution.
Definitions.AiContractRenewals: ContractRenewal ledger entries attributed to execution-time ManagerId.

RootCause: METRIC_ERROR: bilateral-only total compared with completed bilateral+auction purchases per manager. No evidence these counters included bids, evaluations, attempts or renewals.

Baseline.UnavailableReason: 006 did not record these stage events; zero must not be inferred.

CanonicalTransactions.NullSeller: Auction is for a player whose contract expired; no club seller and no seller credit. FormerClubId is not a seller.
CanonicalTransactions.AmountConvention: negative financial debit; paid amount is its absolute value

Retention: Live world snapshot prunes old transactions; the complete 100-season per-manager evidence is archived in ledger.jsonl.gz and actions.jsonl.gz. Do not query a two-season snapshot as an entire career.
